note: Locked before any fitting, per Ben's 7 Nov decision ('all data, lock now'). Drawn from identifiers only (animal/recording/strain/neuron/corpus-item names and counts), never from measured traces, kinematics or scores. Two existing seals (Randi 2023 stimulated-neuron split + all unc-31 animals, from FIT1.md; RIM held out as a whole ephys class, from FIT2.md) are kept exactly as drawn, not re-drawn. Everything else here is a new draw with numpy.random.default_rng(20261107), done once, in the fixed order recorded in each dataset's 'procedure' field.

randi2023.unit: stimulated neuron (wild-type, strain AML462, matched to a model cell); animal and strain (unc-31, strain AML508, held out as a whole genotype)
randi2023.n_units: 171 wild-type stimulated neurons (137 training + 34 held out); 18 unc-31 animals / 108 unc-31 stimulated neurons, all held out
locked: ALL_UNC31_ANIMALS (strain AML508, 18 animals, 108 stimulated neurons, 9011 terms, source funatlas.h5)
randi2023.existing_seal: docs/worm/FIT1.md section 1 (seed 20261106, run 22:30 7 Nov pre-registration); unc-31 sealed separately for the peptide-layer test, FIT1.md section 7
randi2023.procedure: Kept exactly as sealed on 2026-11-06/07. Not re-drawn. The wild-type 34/171 split is by stimulated neuron (20%, seed 20261106). Every unc-31 term is sealed in full (not a fraction) because it is reserved for the UNC-31/CAPS peptide-release test, which needs the whole mutant cohort, not a sample of it.

ephys_single_cell.unit: neuron class (one current/voltage-clamp recording series per class)
ephys_single_cell.existing_seal: docs/worm/FIT2.md section 7 (numpy.random.default_rng(20261107).choice(['RIM','AFD','AWA']) returned RIM, drawn 2026-11-07 01:51:50 CST)
ephys_single_cell.procedure: Kept exactly as sealed. The 4 classes with ephys on backhouse are AIY, RIM, AFD (ephys/naudin2022_liu_aiy_rim_afd/) and AWA (liu2018_awa_ephys/). AIY is never a held-out candidate (its data are already spent or training-only, FIT2.md section 2). RIM is held out as a whole class: its FIT2 sweeps, odd sweeps, and all voltage-clamp data stay sealed. AFD and AWA remain available (AFD partially, AWA fully) for training; this is unchanged, not a new lock.

atanas2023.unit: animal recording, grouped by condition (source study: atanas2023_main, dag2023, pradhan2025, all freely-moving whole-brain NeuroPAL+GCaMP recordings, found together as a family on backhouse)
atanas2023.excluded_from_pool: atanas2023/processed_h5/scrambled-2022-10-03-01/ (11 files): a derived shuffled-neuron-identity copy of 11 of the atanas2023_main animals, not independent data. Not counted as a unit and not eligible for locking either way.
atanas2023.procedure: Decided before drawing: atanas2023_main is the primary whole-brain fitting corpus (docs/worm/SCOREBOARD.md item 75, loss L3), so it was fixed in advance to get the standard 25%-of-animals treatment rather than risk being the whole-condition pick. The whole-condition lock was then drawn with numpy.random.default_rng(20261107) only between the two newer, smaller secondary collections (dag2023, pradhan2025, found alongside atanas2023 under worm-data/wormwideweb_extra/, not yet described in MANIFEST.md). The draw order was: (1) 25% of atanas2023_main's 80 animals (ceil=20) by rng.choice; (2) rng.choice(['dag2023','pradhan2025']) to pick which one is locked whole -> pradhan2025; (3) 25% of dag2023's 15 animals (ceil=4) by rng.choice.

owmd_javer2018.unit: strain / genotype (Open Worm Movement Database subset curated for this project: N2 wild-type plus 16 named mutant strains, Tierpsy/WCON tracks)
owmd_javer2018.procedure: 25% of the 17 strains (ceil=5) drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(20261107).choice: unc-29, unc-31, unc-38, egl-2, flp-1. Unioned with any strain whose gene is also locked in this file's perturbation_corpus draw below (egl-2, flp-1, unc-17), so a gene's real tracking data is never left open for fitting while that same gene's own no-refit mutant test is sealed elsewhere. That union added unc-17, for a final 6 of 17 (35%). N2 and the other 11 mutant strains (cat-2, egl-19, mod-1, npr-1, tdc-1, tph-1, unc-103, unc-2, unc-7, unc-9) are not locked and stay available for the first fitting loss.

yemini2013.unit: strain (one row per genotype/strain in the 305-strain phenome supplement; 304 data rows after the header)
yemini2013.procedure: 25% of the 304 strains (ceil=76) drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(20261107).choice over the strain list read from nmeth2560_MOESM84_SuppTable1.xlsx (sheet 'sigs.csv', columns Genotype/Strain/Outcrossed only; no feature data opened).

neuropal2021.unit: animal recording (one microfluidic NeuroPAL+GCaMP imaging session, strain OH16230; each session has a paired Heads and Tails volume)
neuropal2021.procedure: Only one strain/condition (OH16230) is on backhouse for this dataset (neuropal2021/microfluidic_gcamp/). 25% of its 21 recording sessions (ceil=6) drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(20261107).choice. Per docs/worm/SCOREBOARD.md section 17, NeuroPAL data is not itself scored as a blind behavioural prediction (it is the identity/colour ground truth for the observation model); this lock reserves a slice of it anyway, consistent with Ben's 7 Nov instruction to lock across every dataset held, for the same pipeline-consistency check once scoring starts. neuropal2021/manuals_and_images/ and neuropal2021/plasmids/ contain protocol documents and construct maps, not animal recordings, and are not split.

perturbation_corpus.unit: corpus item: a named gene mutant, neuron ablation, or pharmacological-stimulus assay proposed in docs/worm/research/PERTURBATION_CORPUS.md section 4 or docs/worm/SCOREBOARD.md section 15/18 as a future no-refit test
perturbation_corpus.procedure: The 22 in-scope items are the 20 genes/gene-pairs in PERTURBATION_CORPUS.md section 4's numbered list, plus tdc-1 (SCOREBOARD.md item 97, not in that list), plus the AVA/AVB/PVC/AVD neuron ablation (SCOREBOARD.md item 73, the only ablation item identified; no chemical/optogenetic-stimulus-only item or second ablation dataset was found on backhouse, so the 'stimuli' stratum is read as the items whose primary readout is a pharmacological dose-response assay: slo-1 ethanol, unc-49 aldicarb/levamisole, unc-29/unc-38 levamisole, unc-17 aldicarb). Stratified draw with numpy.random.default_rng(20261107): the single ablation item is locked outright (nothing to draw); 2 of the 4 stimulus items drawn -> slo-1, unc-17; 4 of the remaining 17 mutant items drawn -> egl-2, flp-1, glr-1, unc-36. Total 7 of 22 (32%). No raw ablation or drug-dose-response trace data for these items was found on backhouse (checked); this lock reserves the identifiers so that if such data (or a cited literature phenotype call) is used later, these are the items withheld from informing any fitted value, per SCOREBOARD.md section 15's rule that mutant/ablation predictions are never used to tune the model.

wormbase_phenotype.n_units: ~20,000 genes genome-wide (not counted exactly; reference lookup, see procedure)
wormbase_phenotype.procedure: Not split. wormbase_phenotype/ (phenotype_association.WS298.wb.gz, phenotype_ontology.WS298.obo.gz) is a genome-wide categorical gene-to-phenotype-term lookup table, used only to check whether a gene in the model's scope has a citable phenotype call; it carries no per-animal measured value and is never itself fit against. The genes actually tested against measured data are the perturbation_corpus items above, which is where the lock applies.

not_split_unchanged.note: Checked against MANIFEST.md and the disk; kept as pure fitting priors (structural/connectome/expression reference tables, not repeated-measurement corpora), per their existing FIT designation in docs/worm/SCOREBOARD.md (items 76-78, 90) and docs/worm/MANIFEST.md. Not reopened.
